name: Process Ohio Corporation
old_description: Your Source for Material Handlers, Attachments & Recycling Equipment
about:
Process Equipment, based in New Waterford, Ohio, operates as an independent dealer of material handlers, attachments, and recycling equipment. The company has served the scrap, recycling, waste, demolition, port, and industrial material-handling sectors for over three decades, building a reputation for supplying work-ready machinery from major OEMs.

The company stocks a large inventory of new, used, and rebuilt material handlers from brands such as Caterpillar, Sennebogen, Liebherr, and Fuchs, along with attachments including orange-peel grapples from Rotobec, Pro-Lift, and Kinshofer, as well as magnets and shredders from Wolf and Hammel. Process Equipment buys each machine, subjects it to a 210-point internal inspection supplemented by third-party verification, and then offers it with installation support, parts supply, and service. New inventory arrives weekly, and the company arranges nationwide and international shipping.

Customers include scrap yards, materials recovery facilities, timber and lumber mills, port terminals, demolition contractors, and steel mills. Typical applications cover scrap and metal recycling, waste transfer and MRF operations, bulk material handling at ports, and timber yard processing.

Process Equipment distinguishes itself by not acting as a broker; it takes ownership of every unit, reconditions it to a consistent quality standard, and provides transparent documentation such as video walkthroughs, detailed photo packages, and fluid analysis. The goal is to deliver a purchasing experience close to buying new without the new-machine price, backed by independent, expert advice.
